claims.claim_text: On February 19, 2024, Capital One entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Discover Financial Services, with Discover shareholders to receive 1.0192 shares of Capital One common stock per Discover share.
claims.source_quote: On February 19, 2024, the Company entered into an agreement and plan of merger (the Merger Agreement ), by and among Capital One, Discover Financial Services... each share of common stock of Discover outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the Merger... will be converted into the right to receive 1.0192 shares of common stock of Capital One.
claims.subject: Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.extraction_notes: Counterparty disclosure check: Discover's CIK is 0000007789. The merger should appear in Discover's own 8-K/proxy filings before cutoff. Hard adjudication: an authentic merger generates filings on both sides.

claims.claim_text: Capital One relies on Amazon Web Services (AWS) as its cloud infrastructure provider.
claims.source_quote: We continue to rely on third-party service providers to help us deliver systems and operational infrastructure. These relationships include, but are not limited to: Amazon Web Services, Inc. ( AWS ) for our cloud infrastructure
claims.subject: Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.extraction_notes: Cohort Layer 3 Rule 7: material vendor relationship may appear in AMZN filings. AMZN rarely discloses individual customer names, so this is a weak corroboration channel - expect UNVERIFIABLE-leaning. Bar is high.

proposed_connector.name: fdic_call_reports.query_bank_capital_ratios
proposed_connector.description: FDIC Call Report regulatory capital ratios (CET1, Tier 1, Total, Leverage) per institution per quarter
proposed_connector.rationale: Call Report capital ratios are filed quarterly by every FDIC-chartered bank and are the authoritative cross-check for any 10-K-stated CET1/Tier 1 ratio. Existing fdic_call_reports connectors in catalog cover credit-portfolio fields (LNCONOTH, NTLNLS) but not CET1 ratio explicitly.

claims.extraction_notes: Existing fdic_call_reports.query_bank_credit_history connector returns LNCONOTH/charge-off fields, not CET1. Proposing a sibling connector for regulatory capital fields.

claims.claim_text: Capital One maintains both a credit-card securitization program and an auto-loan securitization program (programs are presumed to continue issuing through 2023).
claims.source_quote: We maintain a credit card securitization program and selectively sell charged-off credit card loans... We maintain an auto securitization program.
claims.subject: Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.extraction_notes: Active securitization issuance produces a steady stream of ABS-15G / ABS-EE / 10-D filings. Absence of any such filings over 2022-2024 would be a contradiction. Note: program may file under sponsor or trust CIKs - this is sponsor-CIK lookup; absence here would prompt trust-CIK search but the sponsor-CIK route is the cleanest first cut.

claims.claim_text: Capital One had 51,987 employees worldwide as of December 31, 2023.
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023, Capital One had 51,987 employees worldwide, whom we refer to as associates.
claims.subject: Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.extraction_notes: No authoritative external registry for company-reported headcount. SEC EDGAR full-text could find the figure echoed in other COF filings (10-Q, proxy) but that is self-corroboration, not independent adjudication. Marking NONE per Step 4c.

claims.claim_text: Capital One's common stock is listed on the NYSE under the symbol COF, with 380.4 million shares outstanding and a $49.9 billion market capitalization at year-end 2023.
claims.source_quote: Our common stock is listed on the NYSE and is traded under the symbol COF... Common shares outstanding (period-end, in millions) 380.4 ... Total market capitalization (period-end) 49,877
claims.subject: Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.extraction_notes: Filing-cadence proxy: an actively-listed NYSE issuer files 10-K + 4 x 10-Q + DEF 14A + numerous 8-Ks each year. Absence of this filing pattern would contradict 'listed and operational' status. Direct NYSE membership registry not in catalog.

claims.claim_text: Capital One had $441.3 billion in total unfunded lending commitments as of December 31, 2023 (primarily credit card lines), up from $409.3 billion at year-end 2022.
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023 and 2022, our total unfunded lending commitments were $441.3 billion and $409.3 billion, respectively, primarily consisting of credit card lines and loan commitments to customers of both our Commercial Banking and Consumer Banking businesses
claims.subject: Capital One Financial Corporation

proposed_connector.name: fdic_call_reports.query_unfunded_commitments
proposed_connector.description: FDIC Call Report unfunded credit-card and lending commitments (Schedule RC-L) per institution per quarter
proposed_connector.rationale: Schedule RC-L of the Call Report breaks out unused credit card lines and other unfunded commitments at the bank-charter level. This is the authoritative public cross-check for any 10-K-stated unfunded commitment figure from a U.S. national bank. Existing fdic_call_reports connectors do not expose Schedule RC-L commitment fields.

claims.extraction_notes: Bank-level unfunded commitments are a Schedule RC-L line item that is publicly filed but not currently exposed by the catalog's Call Report connectors. Propose a sibling connector.
